images.caption: Default approved design: compact sidebar and native-layout review stage.
Worktrees: compact groups, title-inline tags and icon-only agent status.
Header order: directory, Beats, Taskboard, History, Settings, Fermata.
Sub-agents: verified ancestry, reduced indentation and compact tags.
Workspace: real hierarchy concepts, pane-local surfaces and no explanatory clutter.
Workspace-name-only hover; eye, backlog, menu and collapse controls do not trigger it.
Hovered agent details and its pet stay separate from the pinned active agent. Values are synthetic.
Shared slug colors; tags are unchanged in size, inline with agent names, aligned right.
Human swatch overrides apply everywhere; automatic colors derive from the slug.
Human tag assignment and tag colors preserve agent-owned tag attribution.
Independent per-agent pet choice, reset and visibility; original placeholder artwork.
Browser appearance picker with explicit website-favicon mode; no favicon fetching is demonstrated.
History preserves completed activity and open-chat versus explicit exit semantics.
Workspace-specific finished visibility: first eye enabled, second unaffected.
Agent overflow keeps focus, appearance, tags and lifecycle actions separate.
Workspace menu and adjacent per-workspace eye/backlog affordances.
Working-agent exit requires explicit confirmation; simulated only.
Parent-only versus exact descendant scope; no live lifecycle action.
Header gear opens Maestro settings; guide status is a simulated scenario.
Beats content tab: exact agent, cron, prompt and per-Beat queued state.
Inline wand opens friendly controls that fill a single cron expression.
Two extra triggers leave only one pending occurrence; scheduling controls are explicit simulation.
Taskboard is a reusable content tab, not a sidebar grouping mode.
Move a utility view to a pane/workspace without changing agents or Beats.
Directory-plus entry point; example-path simulation stands in for a native directory chooser.
Final header icon: musical fermata, Keep Mac Awake on/off; local demo state only.
Real prototype drag gesture: insertion line among sibling rows; no reparenting.
Explicit test-only eight-level fixture at 280px; not part of the default demo.
